atoms.b: To convert a fraction with denominator 10, 100 or 1,000 to a decimal number, write the ((++numerator denominator)) after the decimal point with the appropriate number of zeroes before it.

To find an equivalent decimal to 3/10, write the 3 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it.

3/10=++0.3 30 0.03
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to 3/10, write the 3 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it. 3 tenths is equal to 0.3.

atoms.b:
To find an equivalent decimal to 3/100, write the 3 after the decimal point with one zero before it.

3/100=++0.03 30 0.3
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to 3/100, write the 3 after the decimal point with one zero before it. 3 hundredths is equal to 0.03.

atoms.b:
To find an equivalent decimal to 3/1000, write the 3 after the decimal point with two zeroes before it.

3/1000=++0.003 0.3 0.03
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to 3/1000, write the 3 after the decimal point with two zeroes before it. 3 thousandths is equal to 0.003.

atoms.b:
To find an equivalent decimal to 27/100, write the 27 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it.

27/100=++0.27 27 0.027
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to 27/100, write the 27 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it. 27 hundredths is equal to 0.27.

atoms.b:
To find an equivalent decimal to 567/1000, write the 567 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it.

567/1000=++0.567 5.67 0.0567
atoms.sound: To find an equivalent decimal to 567/1000, write the 567 after the decimal point with no zeroes before it. 567 thousandths is equal to 0.567.
